name: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations
issuing_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Final May 2024. Restructures the 800-171 family numbering (e.g., 03.01.01) and aligns with 800-53 Rev 5. Adoption is rolling out — DoD CMMC and many federal contracts still anchor on Rev 2.

derives_from.note: Requirements derived from moderate-baseline 800-53 Rev 5 controls tailored for nonfederal systems.
CUI regulation requires nonfederal systems handling CUI to meet 800-171 requirements.
